examples.arabic: ليلى طفلة فضولية جدا بتسال اسئلة كتير لدرجة ان جدها ساعات بيواجه صعوبة في الرد عليها
examples.english: Leila is a very curious child who asks many questions to the extent that her grandfather sometimes faces difficulty answering them.
examples.transliteration: Layla tefla fodouleya geddan betesal as'ela keteer ledaraget en geddaha sa'aat beywageh soouba fel radd aleiha
examples.storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

examples.arabic: سارة قالت انها الفترة دي بيواجه صعوبة في تنظيم وقتها بين الشغل والبيت
examples.english: Sarah said that this period she faces difficulty organizing her time between work and home
examples.transliteration: Sara 'alet en-naha el-fatara di beywageh soouba fi tanzim wa't-ha bein el-shoghl wel-beit
